announcement.transcript: Attention students! The library will be closed for renovations from May 1st to May 15th. Please plan accordingly and return all borrowed materials before the closure. Thank you for your understanding.

questions.q: When will the library be closed?
options: For the entire month of May.

questions.q: What should students do before the library closes?

talk.transcript: Today, we will discuss the concept of photosynthesis, which is vital for plant life. Photosynthesis is the process by which green plants convert sunlight into chemical energy. This occurs mainly in the chloroplasts, where chlorophyll captures sunlight. The process takes in carbon dioxide and water, producing glucose and oxygen. This not only feeds the plant but also releases oxygen into the atmosphere, which is essential for most life forms on Earth. Understanding photosynthesis helps us appreciate the importance of plants in our ecosystem.

questions.explain: 光合作用是植物將陽光轉化為化學能的過程。
光合作用主要在葉片中的葉綠體進行。

questions.q: What are the products of photosynthesis?
questions.explain: 光合作用的產物是葡萄糖和氧氣。

questions.q: Why is photosynthesis important for life on Earth?
questions.explain: 光合作用對地球上的生命至關重要，因為它產生食物和氧氣。
